decisions.hidden_reasoning:
My Garchomp is at 1 HP, +1 Spe, -1 Def. Opposing Garchomp came in. I move first (253 vs 109-169).

Scale Shot is super effective on opposing Garchomp — 2-5 hits at 25 BP. At 1 HP, I should attack before dying. Scale Shot super effective: 25 BP * 2 = 50 per hit, 2-5 hits = 100-250 damage. Opposing Garchomp has 183-215 HP and 103-161 Def. My Atk 182.

Damage per hit: (2*50/50+2) * 182 * 25 / Def / 50 ... let me estimate. Standard formula: ((2*50/5+2)*182*25/Def)/50+2 roughly. Actually simpler: base 100 EQ does about 100% to neutral. Scale shot hit at 25 BP super effective = 50 BP effective, so about half of a neutral 100 BP hit... roughly 40-50% per hit depending on Def. 2 hits = ~80-100%, 3 hits = kill.

Alternatively, I could set up Stealth Rock or Swords Dance — but I'm at 1 HP, opposing Garchomp will kill me. I should attack. Scale Shot is super effective and also boosts my Spe further (already +1).

Actually, should I switch to Kingambit? Opposing Garchomp likely uses EQ which Kingambit is... Kingambit is Dark/Steel, not immune to Ground. Gholdengo is Steel/Ghost — also not immune. Neither is immune to EQ. So switching doesn't help much.

Best: attack with Scale Shot for super effective damage. If it kills, great. If not, I go down but I've done damage.

Earthquake is 100 BP neutral — Scale Shot 2-5 hits at 25 BP super effective = 50-125 effective BP with STAB... wait, Garchomp is Dragon/Ground, Scale Shot is Dragon — gets STAB. So 25*1.5 = 37.5 per hit, super effective = 75 effective per hit. 2 hits = 150, 3 hits = 225. EQ = 100*1.5 = 150 neutral. Scale Shot is better on average and has a chance to hit 3+ times for a KO.

Also Scale Shot lowers my Def (already -1) but boosts Spe.

I'll use Scale Shot.
